¿Quién empieza? Sacude el cacho: el dado: Who goes first? Shake the dice cup: the highest die goes first.
¿Quién empieza? Todos sacuden el cacho a: Who goes first? Everyone shakes the dice cup at once and slams it down: the highest die goes first. If there's a tie at the top, only the tied players shake again. The host can change this in More settings.
Agita el dado manteniendo el botón o Esp: Shake the die by holding the button or Space and let go, or throw it by dragging across the table. The more you shake it, the harder it flies; strength doesn't change the number.
Agitar el dado; suelta para tirar: Shake the die; let go to roll
Arrastra y suelta en la mesa: Drag and drop on the table
Cada pana tiene cuatro fichas. Gana quie: Each player has four pieces. Whoever gets all four to the center wins.
You can come out with a one or a six.
Double border: safe. No capturing here.
El anfitrión elige si sales con seis o c: The host picks whether you come out with a six or with a one and a six. When it comes out, the piece sits on the start square.
La partida continúa mientras estás en el: The game goes on while you're in the menu.
Las casillas con doble borde y un círcul: Squares with a double border and a circle are safe: no capturing there. On the others, landing on rival pieces sends them back to their yard. The room can give another roll for a capture.
Las fichas pueden compartir casilla y no: Pieces can share a square and don't form barriers. The lane in your color is private. You need the exact number to get home.
Mantén el botón o Espacio para agitar el: Hold the button or Space to shake the die and let go to roll, or drag it and drop it on the table.
Movimiento automático después de ver el: Automatic move after the die is seen.
No pudimos abrir la mesa. Comprueba tu c: We couldn't open the table. Check your connection and WebGL.
Poniendo las fichas sobre la mesa…: Putting the pieces on the table…
Roll a six to come out.
Saca un seis para salir. Captura a tus r: Roll a six to come out. Capture your rivals and bring your four pieces to the center with the exact number.
Sal con uno o seis. Captura a tus rivale: Come out with a one or a six. Capture your rivals and bring your four pieces to the center with the exact number.
Salida asistida tras varios intentos sin: Assisted start after several tries without coming out.

Salida asistida: {n} intentos sin salir..one: Assisted start: {n} try without coming out.
Salida asistida: {n} intentos sin salir..other: Assisted start: {n} tries without coming out.

Salida asistida: ayuda tras un límite al: Assisted start: help after a random limit of three to five tries without coming out.
Salida asistida: si todas tus fichas pen: Assisted start: if all your remaining pieces are in the yard, after a random limit of three to five failed tries a six comes up. It applies to everyone; the room can pick classic luck.
Si no tienes movimiento, el turno pasa a: If you have no move, the turn passes automatically. Empty seats play as bots; a friend who joins takes over a bot's pieces.
Tablero de Ludo en tres dimensiones. Tam: 3D Ludo board. You can also move with the piece buttons.
Tira el dado, captura fichas y lleva tus: Roll the die, capture pieces and bring your four pieces home. A 3D table to play with your friends or against bots.
Tocar una ficha marcada o su botón: Tap a highlighted piece or its button
Tres seis seguidos pierden turno: Three sixes in a row lose the turn
Three sixes in a row: turn lost.
Un seis permite volver a tirar. Si la sa: A six lets you roll again. If the room turns the rule on, the third six in a row loses that roll and ends the turn; earlier moves stay.
Un único movimiento legal se hace solo a: A single legal move happens by itself when the die lands. If you can only bring pieces out of the yard, the first one comes out automatically.
